description: Day-ahead total generation forecast (ENTSO-E article 14.1.C) for the Slovak (SEPS) bidding zone.
_areas_note: Bidding-zone / control-area EIC codes to scrape, one API request each. Add more entries to cover more countries in the same run -- each one becomes its own set of rows, distinguished by the request_area column. Verified examples: '10YCZ-CEPS-----N' (Czechia), '10YAT-APG------L' (Austria).
_query_template_note: Report selectors, sent verbatim as query parameters. '{area}' is replaced with the area being fetched -- which parameter carries it differs per report (in_Domain here, outBiddingZone_Domain for load), so it lives in the template rather than in code. periodStart/periodEnd are computed from timezone + date_offset_days and added automatically; securityToken is added at runtime from its SecureString parameter and must never appear here.
